summary: The person who opens a caucus asks whether anyone else wants to chair the rest of it.
realLife: At the 21st District's 2018 caucus, another member nominated the temporary chair for permanent chair; the chair called for more nominations before a unanimous voice vote.
inGame: needs: temporary appointment and open nominations.

turns.what: The members vote on the nominee.
turns.writesBack: The chair's authority now comes from the caucus vote.

turns.pulledBy: A second person accepts a nomination.
turns.what: The temporary chair sends the contest to the caucus election procedure.
turns.writesBack: The opening appointment no longer settles who presides.
